policy: All output files including full-resolution images are byte-compared. Only timing files excluded. 2048 gate measured in run1 and replayed in run2.
publication_note: Historical comparison of the complete original outputs: 221 files per run plus logs, excluding timings.json. Recorded file hashes precede path sanitization and metadata annotations, so they are not hashes of the redistributed JSON files. Image and log artifacts are created when reproducing and are not distributed. Fresh comparison evidence is written to ../reproduced/determinism.json.
